basic_info.description: One of a kind, architect John Lum reimagined, Queen Anne Victorian FOREVER home in the heart of the City! 99 WalkScore, 98 BikeScore. Warmest weather in SF, mins to Tech offices, fwys, BART. Walk to world class shops, cafes and restaurants - like Heath Ceramics, Tartine Manufactory, Flour & Water, San Ho Won, Heirloom Cafe. And inside it's even better: ~4300 sft on 4 levels, 5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, a family room, 3 primary suite options, open floor plan, soaring ceilings, incredible details, a dream kitchen with sliding Fleetwood glass wall to sun-drenched, gas-plumbed deck and magical, blooming garden w basketball hoop! Liebherr, Wolf, Miele, 2 KitchenAid dishwashers, 2 sinks (one w on demand hot water), massive Neolith island, Calacatta marble backsplash. Amazing home for entertaining, work from home, intergen living, large families w au pair. 3BDRs and 2BAs on one level. Downtown and Twin Peaks views from top level. 2 laundry stations. 2 car garage pkg w ample storage. Seismic retrofit, new foundation, plumbing and electrical. Wide plank wood flrs, coded gate for package delivery, Lutron Caseta whole-house lighting system, 3-zone heating w 2 Nest thermostats, 2 Navien 240S tankless water heaters, whole-house air purification sys, drip irrigation. Urban dwellers dream! Must see!
